subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution is related with the Right of President to address and send messages to Houses?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 86.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 86 of the Indian Constitution is related to the Right of the President to address and send messages to Houses.
 
• **Article 86** is captioned **"The President's Right to Address and Send Messages to Houses." **The President may address any House of Parliament or both Houses assembled together, and the attendance of members is required for this purpose.
 
• The President may transmit messages to either House of Parliament, whether in relation to a Bill currently pending in Parliament or otherwise, and any House to whom a message is conveyed shall consider any subject required by the message to be taken into account as soon as possible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 88 deals with the rights of ministers and the attorney general in relation to the Houses. Every Minister and the Attorney-General of India shall have the right to speak in, and otherwise participate in, He may attend the proceedings of either House, any joint sitting of the Houses, and any committee of Parliament to which he may be appointed, but he shall not have the right to vote as a result of this article.
 
• Article 90 deals with vacation, resignation, and removal from the position of Deputy Chairman.
